description: ENCRYPT_RAW / DECRYPT_RAW - raw-key AES-GCM. ENCRYPT_RAW returns a VARIANT OBJECT {ciphertext, iv, tag}; DECRYPT_RAW consumes those and returns the decrypted BINARY. Its optionals nest from the LEFT (live-measured): the 4th argument is always the AAD, the 5th the method, and the AEAD tag sits strictly 6th - so a no-AAD round trip passes an EMPTY BINARY AAD, cryptographically identical to none, just to reach the tag position. A call that stops before the sixth position therefore has no tag at all, whatever it passed fourth, and fails "Decryption mode requires an AEAD tag as parameter"; a sixth argument of the wrong length reports the byte counts verbatim. Snowflake's raw-crypto functions take BINARY and reject a hex VARCHAR outright, so every argument goes through TO_BINARY, and BINARY values read back as uppercase hex. Converted 1:1 from functions/EncryptRawTest (now retired); the Java class captured the ciphertext and tag from the ENCRYPT_RAW object into Java locals, which the converted suite does with a CTE so the object is produced once and both members are read from it in the same statement.

steps.sql: WITH e AS (SELECT ENCRYPT_RAW(TO_BINARY('hello world','UTF-8'), TO_BINARY('000102030405060708090A0B0C0D0E0F101112131415161718191A1B1C1D1E1F','HEX'), TO_BINARY('0102030405060708090A0B0C','HEX')) AS o) SELECT o:ciphertext IS NOT NULL, o:tag IS NOT NULL, o:iv::VARCHAR FROM e

WITH e AS (SELECT ENCRYPT_RAW(TO_BINARY('hello world','UTF-8'), TO_BINARY('000102030405060708090A0B0C0D0E0F101112131415161718191A1B1C1D1E1F','HEX'), TO_BINARY('0102030405060708090A0B0C','HEX')) AS o) SELECT DECRYPT_RAW(TO_BINARY(o:ciphertext::VARCHAR,'HEX'), TO_BINARY('000102030405060708090A0B0C0D0E0F101112131415161718191A1B1C1D1E1F','HEX'), TO_BINARY('0102030405060708090A0B0C','HEX'), TO_BINARY('','HEX'), 'AES-GCM', TO_BINARY(o:tag::VARCHAR,'HEX')) FROM e

WITH e AS (SELECT ENCRYPT_RAW(TO_BINARY('data','UTF-8'), TO_BINARY('000102030405060708090A0B0C0D0E0F101112131415161718191A1B1C1D1E1F','HEX'), TO_BINARY('0102030405060708090A0B0C','HEX')) AS o) SELECT DECRYPT_RAW(TO_BINARY(o:ciphertext::VARCHAR,'HEX'), TO_BINARY('000102030405060708090A0B0C0D0E0F101112131415161718191A1B1C1D1E1F','HEX'), TO_BINARY('0102030405060708090A0B0C','HEX'), TO_BINARY(o:tag::VARCHAR,'HEX')) FROM e

error.messageContains: Decryption mode requires an AEAD tag as parameter

steps.sql: WITH e AS (SELECT ENCRYPT_RAW(TO_BINARY('data','UTF-8'), TO_BINARY('000102030405060708090A0B0C0D0E0F101112131415161718191A1B1C1D1E1F','HEX'), TO_BINARY('0102030405060708090A0B0C','HEX')) AS o) SELECT DECRYPT_RAW(TO_BINARY(o:ciphertext::VARCHAR,'HEX'), TO_BINARY('000102030405060708090A0B0C0D0E0F101112131415161718191A1B1C1D1E1F','HEX'), TO_BINARY('0102030405060708090A0B0C','HEX'), TO_BINARY('','HEX'), 'AES-GCM', TO_BINARY('AB','HEX')) FROM e

error.messageContains: Wrong AEAD tag size. Expected 16, but got 1

steps.sql: WITH e AS (SELECT ENCRYPT_RAW(TO_BINARY('top secret','UTF-8'), TO_BINARY('000102030405060708090A0B0C0D0E0F101112131415161718191A1B1C1D1E1F','HEX'), TO_BINARY('0102030405060708090A0B0C','HEX'), TO_BINARY('header-v1','UTF-8'), 'AES-GCM') AS o) SELECT DECRYPT_RAW(TO_BINARY(o:ciphertext::VARCHAR,'HEX'), TO_BINARY('000102030405060708090A0B0C0D0E0F101112131415161718191A1B1C1D1E1F','HEX'), TO_BINARY('0102030405060708090A0B0C','HEX'), TO_BINARY('header-v1','UTF-8'), 'AES-GCM', TO_BINARY(o:tag::VARCHAR,'HEX')) FROM e

WITH e AS (SELECT ENCRYPT_RAW(TO_BINARY('data','UTF-8'), TO_BINARY('000102030405060708090A0B0C0D0E0F101112131415161718191A1B1C1D1E1F','HEX'), TO_BINARY('0102030405060708090A0B0C','HEX')) AS o) SELECT DECRYPT_RAW(TO_BINARY(o:ciphertext::VARCHAR,'HEX'), TO_BINARY('000102030405060708090A0B0C0D0E0F101112131415161718191A1B1C1D1E1F','HEX'), TO_BINARY('0102030405060708090A0B0C','HEX'), TO_BINARY('','HEX'), 'AES-GCM', TO_BINARY(LEFT(o:tag::VARCHAR, 31) || IFF(RIGHT(o:tag::VARCHAR, 1) = '0', '1', '0'), 'HEX')) FROM e

WITH e AS (SELECT ENCRYPT_RAW(TO_BINARY('data','UTF-8'), TO_BINARY('000102030405060708090A0B0C0D0E0F101112131415161718191A1B1C1D1E1F','HEX'), TO_BINARY('0102030405060708090A0B0C','HEX')) AS o) SELECT DECRYPT_RAW(TO_BINARY(o:ciphertext::VARCHAR,'HEX'), TO_BINARY('FF0102030405060708090A0B0C0D0E0F101112131415161718191A1B1C1D1E1F','HEX'), TO_BINARY('0102030405060708090A0B0C','HEX'), TO_BINARY('','HEX'), 'AES-GCM', TO_BINARY(o:tag::VARCHAR,'HEX')) FROM e
